label: refusalIsSuccess: a move the kernel refuses still gives a reorder index, so a command is issued anyway
reversedProjection: the tree's roots are built top first, so frontToBack and rows come out bottom first
offByOneMove: the panel row maps to one bottom-first index too high
find: try tree.move(id, into: nil, at: count - 1 - row)
replace: try tree.move(id, into: nil, at: count - row)

label: flagsSwapped: a row's hidden flag is read from the layer's lock
